question: What kind of impurity does pañcagavya-water remove according to the scripture?
premises: The scripture identifies pañcagavya-water as removing external impurity.
Ordinary impurity must be removed first.
Only after that is the inner impurity addressed.
inference: Pañcagavya-water functions at the level of external purification, preparing the way for inner purification.
plain_english: In the scripture, pañcagavya-water is said to remove external impurity; for when ordinary impurity has been removed, one may then deal with the inner impurity.
